$comment: infra/environments.json (owned by bl-devops). Names and rules only, never values. Values are set by Matthew in Vercel / GitHub (see docs/ops/setup-for-matthew.md).

sandboxException.reason: Throwaway DevOps sandbox: there is ONE Supabase project, used for both staging and production.
consequences: Staging previews, lane previews and production read and write the same database.
The api-tests job is not run in CI: tests/helpers/auth.ts refuses a remote Supabase that matches SUPABASE_PROD_PROJECT_REF, and staging IS that project.
Migrations applied by release.yml take effect for staging too.
sandboxException.rule: SANDBOX ONLY. Real client projects never share a Supabase project between staging and production.

vercel.productionGitDeploys: off (vercel.json git.deploymentEnabled.main = false); production is deployed only by .github/workflows/release.yml

production.deployedBy: release.yml (behind the GitHub `production` environment, Matthew approves)

staging.urlNote: Matthew confirms the exact stable branch URL in Vercel > Deployments (see setup-for-matthew.md step 1.6). CI uses the exact deployment URL from the deployment event instead.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.source: Supabase > Project Settings > Data API > Project URL

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.source: Supabase > Project Settings > API Keys > anon (legacy) or publishable key

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.source: Supabase > Project Settings > API Keys > service_role (legacy) or secret key

variables.name: SITE_URL
variables.note: Not a secret, a URL. Production = the production URL. Preview = the stable staging URL, set for ALL preview branches (env-check --vercel requires an all-branches Preview entry; lane previews therefore send sign-in links to staging, which is fine for the sandbox).

variables.name: SESSION_MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.note: Defaults to 30 in code. Leave unset.

systemVariables.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA: Provided by Vercel, never set by hand. GET /api/health reports its first 7 characters as `version`; the release smoke check compares against it.

toolingOnly.note: Read by scripts/ and tests/, never by the deployed app. Must NOT exist in Vercel (env-check --vercel reports them as undeclared if they do).

repository.note: PRODUCTION_URL is a repository variable (not environment-scoped) so the 15-minute uptime check can read it without waiting for production approval.

staging.later: SUPABASE_STAGING_URL, SUPABASE_STAGING_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_STAGING_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are added (as a setting request) only when QA's e2e suite lands and needs them. Not granted to CI before there is a consumer.
